notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Default renderer is now Vulkan.
[*] Updated all UI.
[*] Fixed audio sliders.
[*] Fixed match settings input.
[*] Added basic controller support.
[*] Removed mouse acceleration.
[/list]

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] In Unreal Engine 5.6.1 blueprints, the node "GetSupportedFullscreenResolutions" seems to not work. Resolution box options are no longer dynamically added.
[*] If mouse acceleration is still active, add this to Input.ini, which should be located at 
AppData -> Local -> AimTrainerWithCats -> Saved -> Config -> Windows -> Input.ini. 
If Input.ini does not exist, you can create it.

[i][/Script/Engine.InputSettings]
bEnableMouseSmoothing=False
bViewAccelerationEnabled=False
bDisableMouseAcceleration=True[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Launch Parameters[/h2]
[list]
[*] -windowed
[*] -fullscreen
[*] -ResX=x-ResY=y
[*] -FPS=x
[*] -vulkan
[*] -dx12
[*] -nosound
[/list]

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the player would get stuck in the match settings.
[*] Fixed a bug when resuming from pause while the match settings is open.
[*] Fixed interaction collision detection.
[*] Updated UI backend.
[*] Updated play area.
[/list]

[h2][b]Coming soon[/b][/h2]

[*] Controller support.

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Completely reworked save system, now there is only one save file (You MIGHT need to delete old save data).
[*] Added new crosshair and fixed crosshair color setting.
[*] Fixed audio settings not saving / properly applying.
[*] Added VSync option.
[*] Fixed window mode and full screen setting boxes.
[*] Reworked match settings user interface.
[*] Added look inversion setting.
[/list]
